title: There must be no shosts.equiv files on SLEM 5.
check_content:
Verify there are no "shosts.equiv" files on SLEM 5 with the following command:

     > sudo find /etc -name shosts.equiv

If any "shosts.equiv" files are found on the system, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Remove any "shosts.equiv" files found on SLEM 5.

     > sudo rm /<path_to_file>/shosts.equiv
VulnDiscussion: The shosts.equiv files are used to configure host-based authentication for the system via SSH. Host-based authentication is not sufficient for preventing unauthorized access to the system, as it does not require interactive identification and authentication of a connection request, or for the use of two-factor authentication.
